messages:
Mia: Heads-up — follow-up on the postmortem actions from yesterday's latency incident. I want to confirm owners + realistic timelines for the three items we listed.
Jordan: +1. Quick recap for folks who missed it: recurring p99 spikes on the inference path, correlated with large-batch jobs during the 18:00–19:00 window.
Sam: I pushed a small routing tweak to reduce cold-starts for the model pool, but we need the longer-term KV cache change (PM-428) to stop per-request cache misses.
Harpreet: I can own PM-428. ETA two sprints (target: 2026-04-14). Will drop interim mitigation (more aggressive caching TTL) in this week's deploy.
Mia: Good. Assigning Harpreet -> PM-428. Sam, can you do the TTL mitigation and a quick dashboard tile for immediate visibility?
Sam: Yep — I'll add the tile and put the TTL change behind a feature flag. Deploy planned tomorrow morning. @Lucy can you help validate the rollout metrics?
Lucy: Happy to. I'll watch errors + p95/p99. Link to the dashboard I'll use: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/slo-latency
OpsBot: Incident archived: I-2026-03-12-17 — all alerts resolved and postmortem published. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: On SLOs: Ops team suggests keeping p95 at 120ms but relaxing p99 from 250ms -> 300ms for the short term while we finish the cache work. Thoughts?
Mia: I'm wary of relaxing p99 too much without explicit customer comms. Can we instead reduce error budget consumption via routing & caching so we don't touch contractual SLAs?
Harpreet: Agreed. If we must change SLO, let's document it as a temporary operational adjustment, add it to the postmortem notes, and set a 30-day review.
Sam: Quick math I ran in the eval harness:
```text
current p99: 265ms
target p99 (temp): 300ms
expected error-budget impact: +0.9% over 30 days given current traffic profile
```
Jordan: That's useful. I'd rather move the dashboard alert thresholds before changing the SLO. Change alert from p99>240ms -> p99>280ms with a runbook link.
Mia: OK — action list (short):
- Harpreet: PM-428 KV cache fix — owner, target 2026-04-14
- Sam: TTL mitigation + feature flag + dashboard tile — deploy 2026-03-13
- Lucy: Validation during rollout + escalate if errors spike — watch 18:00–20:00 window
- Jordan: Draft temporary SLO adjustment proposal if mitigations fail; add 30-day review clause
- OpsBot: Add automated weekly trend check for recurring spikes and notify eng-oncall
Harpreet: I'll also add a regression test to the perf CI to simulate large-batch window traffic.
Sam: I'll post the dashboard tile and a short how-to in #eng-sre after deploy.
Lucy: If we see >2 spike events this week, let's trigger a follow-up retrospective with infra + model teams.
Jordan: Noted. I'll put a calendar hold tentatively on 2026-03-20 10:00 for that retrospective (if needed).
Mia: Nicely scoped. Sam/Lucy please add short verification checklist to the postmortem doc when done. We'll re-evaluate SLO language only if mitigations don't reduce p99 burn within 14 days.
OpsBot: Scheduled check created: slo-trend-check weekly at 02:00 UTC — will post summary to #eng-oncall every Monday.
Sam: Done — small PR for the dashboard tile coming in 10m. Will include the Prometheus queries we used.
Harpreet: PR for PM-428 design doc up by EOD.
Mia: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem with these owners/timelines and mark the follow-up in the PM tracker. :thumbsup:
